title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^122.238

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 (modelled 0.3985, proof.md section 7) under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.238 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.237394. Relation collection keeps the accepted frontier's 2601/2500 work and 2401/2500 yield brackets; its f-side ECM cofactor slack is retuned from 292 to 286 bits (surviving f-side cofactors bounded by 294 instead of 300 bits, same five-limb ECM cost), which lowers relation collection from 2^121.8409 to 2^121.8306 units while the retained yield 2^64.169 remains 0.339 bits above 1.3 U, above the model's 0.30-bit feasibility floor. The metered descent cap is 2^118.99 units, above the retuned boot's modelled two-log expectation 2^118.224 (Markov abort <= 2^-0.765, exact 2^-0.765795). Linear algebra uses block sizes (26,5), the minimum of the same per_n2 expression, tightened per-entry charges 90/100 (above the package's measured components 88 and 97), and the filtering/LA pad 1.61, whose charged ratio 1.61 x 0.0471 = 0.07585 still exceeds the worst measured 2^12 filtering seed ratio 0.0757. Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.238 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger and modelled_success.
